label: anchorSign: the anchor offset is taken the wrong way round
find: let offset = Point(x: p.x - anchorX, y: p.y - anchorY)
replace: let offset = Point(x: anchorX - p.x, y: anchorY - p.y)

label: anchorPoint measures from the origin, not the box
find: return Point(x: box.minX + (box.maxX - box.minX) * u, y: box.minY + (box.maxY - box.minY) * v)
replace: return Point(x: (box.maxX - box.minX) * u, y: (box.maxY - box.minY) * v)
